The North's biggest funding stories this week

A quiet week for exits but a busy one for cheques across the North's startup scene.

Newcastle's Palisade Health raised £1.2 million for its care-home software, while Leeds outfit Brightbox took £400,000 for workplace analytics.

Sheffield's Fern Energy closed a £2 million round for heat pumps, and Manchester startup Loopio secured £650,000 for its retail inventory tool.

Analysts said the deals show regional investors remain willing to back early-stage teams.
